name: trident
description: Fourteen Claude skills for creators on YouTube, TikTok and Instagram, in English, Czech, Russian and Romanian: scored hooks off 26 formulas, click-surface and caption linters with current platform limits, one-video-to-three-platforms packaging, multi-part series splitting and handoff diagnosis, retention reading for long and short form, edit decision lists, clips, chapters, comments, planning, audits and an outlier finder.
